problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=⟨4,1⟩$ and $\text{v}=⟨-6,-\frac{3}{2}⟩.$
worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}4 & -6 \\ 1 & -\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}4 & -6 \\ 1 & -\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}| \\  & =4\cdot (-\frac{3}{2})-(-6)\cdot 1 \\  & =-6+6 \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,0\,|=0
$$
